checkpoints.title: [hosts] repos: the person's tool for each repository, read only from the user config, AAYU_HOSTS__REPOS, or --set
contracts: internal/config/config.go: Hosts.Repos []string (koanf hosts.repos), owner/name=tool entries; Hosts.RepoTool(repo) matches owner/name with no case; Validate refuses a bad entry, a space in owner/name, a repository named twice, or a tool outside verbs.Hosts
internal/config/load.go: the repo and local layers may not set hosts.repos, as for [hosts.cursor] plan
instrumentation: the config error names [hosts] repos and the user config
checkpoints.rollback: Revert the squash commit; the key is new, so no stored config needs a change.

checkpoints.title: mission start reads [hosts] repos, and its refusal names the key
contracts: internal/cli/mission.go: Env.repoTool reads the loaded config when Options.RepoTool is nil; Env.noRepoTool names [hosts] repos, the user config file, and --set hosts.repos=<repo>=<tool>
internal/cli/missionlock.go: the inbox start card names [hosts] repos, and says when the config does not load without quoting the error
instrumentation: the plan records the tool and its source
checkpoints.rollback: Revert the squash commit; Start refuses again.
